text.p: Secondhand tonnage brokers reported the sale of the following vessels.
BULKERS - Star Providence - (built 1985) 40,698 dwt sold to Norwegian buyers for $13.5 million on subjects incl.timecharter.
Tacora - (built 1985) 37,715 dwt sold in Chile for $27.5 million.
TANKERS - Jahre Prince - (built 1986) 88,900 dwt sold to Norwegian charterers for $26.5 million.
Morning Glory I - (built 1984) 61,728 dwt sold to Greek buyers for $17.2 million.
Egret - (built 1983) 60,585 dwt sold to Argentina buyers for $14.2 million.
TWEENDECKERS - Isla Floreana - (built 1980) 18,047 dwt plus sistership:
Isla Salanga - (built 1979) 18,047 dwt sold to Indian buyers for $4.6 million "enbloc".
REEFERS - Haru Verdy - (built 1993) 8,042 dwt sold to European buyers for $19 million.
Some of these sales may not be final as they may be subject to inspection, survey or other conditions.
